name: Synoptics Technologies Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2008, Synoptics Technologies 
 Ltd does trade in IT products and provides information & Telecom Technology networking solutions[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) STL is an IT Services company offering solutions in the areas of IT Infrastructure like connectivity to
the Branches, Supply, implementation and support of the network equipment needed 
 to run the IT setup like routers, switches etc.
b) It designs the solution for customers who need to put their applications in the Cloud, helps with the application migration and manages the setup in the cloud. 
c) IT Service solutions like firewall installation and management
d) Data Centre design and solution with newer technology to optimize the investment
e) Synoptics helps organisations in their Digital journey with various use cases of specific industry verticals.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.79 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 12.3% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 160 days.
